what: Instead of the system cursor, an 8px dot follows the cursor 22% per frame, and a 6px accent-colored tail dot chases that dot 10% more slowly. Over links and buttons the dot turns off in .25s and a 34px accent ring (1.5px) turns on in its place. [data-cursor-theme="dark|light"] Over the panel, the dot color flips to the opposite of the background

options.lead: Share of the dot/ring that follows the cursor (per frame), default .22
options.trail: Share by which the tail dot follows the dot, default .1
options.hover: Selector for targets that turn into a ring, default a, button, [role=button], [data-cursor-hover]

use: (dots, rings and tails are created if missing — data-fx-part="dot|ring|tail" can also be preset with)
note: On touch devices (no hover) it does not stick and does not hide the system cursor

from.where: shared.js .rc-cursor (all pages) — original cursor-js: lerp .22·.10, dot 8px·ring 34px 1.5px #900·tail 6px #900, on is-hover dot 0 and ring 1 (.25s ease), data-cursor-theme
